title: Function Health conditions
description: A serif heading with an italic phrase, a row of three terracotta check-circle benefits, and a bordered chart card in the middle with a mono 'pause motion' control under it. Two rows of condition names with dot separators slide sideways in opposite directions as you scroll, passing behind the card on desktop and below it on phones.
notes: the scroll-scrubbed rows use CSS scroll-driven animation (Chrome, Edge, Safari 26); elsewhere the rows stay still
the chart card is a media slot; the rows are plain text lists
pause control stops the slide animation of this block
